name: duckdb-component-web
description: Boot the DuckLink core wasip2 component in the browser via @tegmentum/wasmos-browser + @wasmos/runtime-guest-bridge (wasm-cm's portable runtime-guest driver, no jco). JS bindings generated by wit-js-bindgen --role runtime-guest from the built ducklink_core.wasm.

scripts.copy-wasm: cp ../../duckdb-wasm/target/wasm32-wasip2/release/ducklink_core.wasm public/ && cp ../artifacts/extensions/sample_extension.wasm public/ && cp ../artifacts/extensions/cron.wasm public/ && cp ../artifacts/extensions/cron_scheduler.wasm public/
